title: Automated Attestation Scheduler & Proof Bundle Generator for Regioned Data
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Auditors require per-control proof bundles that show evidence of policy execution, retention windows, and regional residency assertions. Today this work is manual: platform engineers and compliance ops run ad-hoc scripts, copy logs into temporary folders, and create attestations per customer/region. This is slow, error-prone, and blocks Dedicated/Private customers during audits.

Goal: Build an automated attestation scheduler that generates signed 'proof bundles' on a configurable cadence (daily/weekly/on-demand) per customer and per jurisdiction. Each bundle should: (1) map controls to evidence sources (logs, telemetry, config snapshots), (2) sample and collect artifacts using pluggable collector adapters, (3) sign bundles with KMS-backed keys, (4) tag bundles with residency + retention metadata, and (5) export to a region-appropriate evidence vault and the Customer Console (downloadable .tar.gz with manifest.json).

Success metrics:
- Reduce manual audit preparation time by >= 80% for SOC 2/ISO reviews (measured by compliance team survey).
- 0 failures in automated bundle assembly in 30-day rolling window for internal integration tests.
- Ability to produce a signed proof bundle for a sample customer in <= 2 minutes for on-demand mode.

Non-goals: This task does not include the complete UI redesign of the Compliance Console; we will add minimal listing + download controls. Deep archival lifecycle management (tiered cold storage) will be handled in a follow-up.

Out-of-scope: Legal attestation language creation and external auditor integrations (we will expose webhooks and an S3-friendly archive format instead).
acceptance_criteria: Mapping engine can store and return control -> evidence source mappings (JSON manifest) for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls
Collectors can be configured per-tenant and run in sandboxed jobs; at least three collector adapters implemented (API logs, KV cache snapshot, console-activity trace)
Proof bundle manifest includes: control mappings, artifact list with SHA256 checksums, KMS signature reference, residency tag, retention TTL
Bundles are uploaded to region-appropriate vault (s3://redwood-evidence-<region>) and are retrievable via signed URL
On-demand attestation completes end-to-end for a sample tenant within 2 minutes in staging
Automated runs include retry logic and clear error codes surfaced to Console + telemetry
tasks: Design control-mapping schema and manifest format (confluence: /wiki/ControlMappingSchema)
Implement collector adapter interface and three initial adapters
Build bundle builder service that assembles artifacts and computes manifest
Integrate KMS signing and key rotation awareness
Implement scheduler engine with tenant-level cadence and backfill support
Expose minimal Console endpoints: list bundles, download bundle, show last-run status
Add observability: per-bundle metrics, error traces, and retention audit log
comments: 2026-03-01 Maya Chen: Created initial ticket after Compliance working group requested automated proofs for upcoming ISO audit. Drafted scope and success metrics.
2026-03-03 Arun Patel: High-level implementation plan reviewed with infra and runtime teams. Major decision: use KMS-HSM for signature keys; ENG to validate latency impact.
2026-03-05 Lina Gomez (Security): Security review flagged tenant isolation for collector runners. Action: collectors must run with least privilege; SEC-299 opened for RBAC enforcement.
2026-03-08 Product/Eng sync: Chose storage pattern -> per-region evidence buckets + manifest index in Dynamo-like store for fast lookup. Tradeoff: cross-region replication deferred to later.
2026-03-10 Design review: UX will show 'Latest Bundle' and history; full compliance UI redesign deferred. Linked design stub: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COM/Proof+Bundle+UX

2026-03-12 ENG PR: initial collector interface and stub adapters submitted (github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8241). Code owners requested clearer retry semantics; ENG-46800 assigned to address.

2026-03-14 Arun Patel: Staging run successful for internal tenant 'redwood-test-eu': bundle generated, signed, and uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence-eu/archives/redwood-test-eu/2026-03-14-1402.tar.gz. Added follow-up to tighten sampling policy and reduce bundle size for large tenants.
notes: Sampling strategy: default to deterministic sampling for control types that require event-level attestations; allow configurable sample rate per-customer to control cost
Retention tagging: manifest must include retention_policy_id and an ISO-8601 expiration timestamp so automated retention workers can garbage collect safely
Privacy: PII must be redacted by collectors by default. If a customer opts into raw-artifact retention, an explicit consent flag and higher-tier contract is required
Operational runbook: create a playbook for 'failed bundle assembly' that includes common remediation steps and how to re-run for an individual tenant
